# langsmith_agent_environment (Data Source)

Looks up an agent environment by UUID. Environments are owned by agents; the API does not expose public environment create, update, or delete operations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_agent" "support" {
  agent_id = "support-agent"
}

data "langsmith_agent_environment" "production" {
  id = data.langsmith_agent.support.environments["PRODUCTION"].id
}

data "langsmith_agent_environment" "development" {
  workspace_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  id           = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
}

output "production_project_id" {
  value = data.langsmith_agent_environment.production.tracer_session_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Agent environment UUID.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace (tenant) ID. Defaults to the provider workspace.

### Read-Only

- `agent_id` (String) Owning agent identifier.
- `environment` (String) Environment name.
- `tracer_session_id` (String) Tracing project UUID.
- `tracer_session_name` (String) Tracing project name.
